messages:
alex: Noticed recurring p99 spikes on /v1/embeddings. quick root cause: mixed-dim batches (e.g., 768+1024) that force the splitter to degrade to single-vector routing.

maria: ok. how often and how many tenants?

ajordan: about 0.5% of requests but they account for ~30% of p99. samples show >100 vectors in mixed-dim payloads.

lee: we should emit a thin telemetry event at preflight: dims_hint, vectors, bytes, preflight_outcome, selected_route. makes it easy to chart offending combos.

alex: agree. also proposal: tenant-scoped ingress circuit that soft-degrades first (response header suggesting split) and then hard-fails or routes to a limited fallback if sustained.

maria: thresholds idea: if preflight_mismatch_rate > 5% AND rolling p99 > 2s for 3m, mark tenant degraded. unmark after 15m stable. start canary at 2% tenants.

ajordan: add client-side hint header X-Embed-Client-Hint to reduce server parsing for known SDKs. server still validates.

lee: console needs per-tenant timeline, counts fastfailed vs fallback, and a button to force-clear circuit. retention: raw events 7d, hourly aggregates 90d.

ops-bot: deploy-candidate alex/ingress-circuit-probe -> staging started (build 210).

alex: will emit telemetry only first week, then enable soft-degrade header for canary. I'll open a PR for schema.
